title: Move golden-only redactions into LLM-facing output
description:
The golden helpers currently redact some string content during comparison that ideally should never reach the model in the first place. In `puppeteer/tests/golden_helpers.py`, `_normalize_embedded_json()` rewrites raw XMage handle noise such as `object_id='UUID'` attributes and trailing short suffixes like `</font> [abc]` before golden comparison.

If that content is noisy enough that we do not want it preserved in golden fixtures, it is probably also noisy enough that it should not be present in LLM-facing output at all. The preferred fix is to strip or redact those handles at the actual model-facing boundary (bridge / MCP output generation / other prompt-building source), not only inside golden normalization.

Follow-up scope:
- Identify every remaining value class that golden comparison redacts out of embedded strings.
- Trace where those values enter LLM-facing output.
- Move the redaction to the source boundary so models never see the noise.
- Delete the corresponding golden-only redaction once the source output is clean.

Goal: goldens should stay as literal as possible, and the model should never consume transport/UI noise that we already consider non-semantic.
